title: Edit Distance
description: Given two strings `word1` and `word2`, return the minimum number of operations required to convert `word1` to `word2`. Operations permitted: insert, delete, or replace a character.
input_format: Two lines, first is `word1`, second is `word2`.
hints: Base cases: converting to/from empty string costs the length of the string.

reference_solution:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().split()
w1 = lines[0] if len(lines) > 0 else ''
w2 = lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 else ''
m, n = len(w1), len(w2)
dp = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(m+1)]
for i in range(m+1): dp[i][0] = i
for j in range(n+1): dp[0][j] = j
for i in range(1, m+1):
    for j in range(1, n+1):
        if w1[i-1] == w2[j-1]: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]
        else: dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1])
print(dp[m][n])
